baseline.method: Corrected original Occam implementation; real Australian MT profile; no actual truth

observation_rms_definition: sqrt(mean(((modelled_log10_rhoa-observed_log10_rhoa)/sigma_log10_rhoa)^2, ((modelled_phase-observed_phase)/sigma_phase)^2)) over all 46 scalar observations; phase in radians
tolerance_provenance: Independent Octave rerun and NumPy port float64 parity; nonzero numerical tolerance with observation consistency required. See test/validation.md.
